remark_non_strict_counterexample.note: a small/zero residual here would not contradict the remark: the point is that phi_2 = 1 identically keeps token 2's price from ever being driven to make token 1 valuable (connects_2_to_1 is False), so no interior equilibrium with both prices meaningfully determined by market clearing exists; the iteration either drifts to a boundary or fails to stabilize at an interior fixed point reflecting true clearing of both tokens.
